topics.title: Indus River aur is ke kinarey
topics.summary: Indus Pakistan ke daryai aur aabpashi nizam ki bunyaad hai. Is group mein Pakistan ka sab se lamba darya, us ka samandar tak rasta aur Kalabagh aur Rohri ke river-location sawalat ek sath hain.

references.title: Embassy of Pakistan: basic facts and rivers
Federal Flood Commission: river routing

topics.title: Kabul River aur Attock
topics.summary: Kabul River Afghanistan se Pakistan aa kar Attock ke qareeb Indus mein milta hai. Sawalat mein darya ka manba aur dono daryaon ke milne ki jagah ko alag alag yaad karein.

references.title: World Bank archives: Indus and Kabul confluence
World Bank: Afghanistan river systems

topics.title: Jhelum, Neelum aur Muzaffarabad
topics.summary: Jhelum ka manba Verinag Spring hai; Neelum is mein Muzaffarabad ke Domail par milta hai. Darya ka source, Kashmir Valley mein us ka rasta aur confluence ko ek doosre se jor kar parhein.

references.title: AJK Planning and Development: Statistical Year Book 2025

topics.title: Poonch River aur Jhelum ka nizam
topics.summary: Poonch, Jhelum ka tributary yani madadgar darya hai. Is ko Mangla ke ilaqay se jor kar yaad karein; Poonch aur Neelum dono Jhelum system ka hissa hain lekin alag darya hain.

references.title: AJK Archaeology: geographical background
FAO: rivers and fisheries in Azad Jammu and Kashmir

topics.title: Ravi River, Lahore aur Harappa
topics.summary: Lahore ke shumali janib Ravi behta hai. Harappa ke sawal mein darya ke purane course ka zikr hai; is liye aaj ke river channel aur tareekhi course ko ek jaisa na samjhein.

references.title: Government of Punjab: Lahore geographic conditions
Department of Archaeology and Museums: Harappa

topics.title: Sutlej River: manba aur lambai
topics.summary: Sutlej ka manba Tibet ke ilaqay mein hai. Lambai wale sawal mein sirf Pakistan ke andar ka hissa nahi, darya ka poora course compare kiya gaya hai.

references.title: Central Water Commission: Indus basin and Satluj
Embassy of Pakistan: listed river lengths

topics.title: Beas River: Punjab river system
topics.summary: Beas ka source Beas Kund hai. Yeh Pakistan mein alag darya ke taur par dakhil nahi hota; Punjab river system aur 1960 ke treaty ke hawalay se is ka naam parhna zaroori hai.

references.title: Himachal Pradesh: Beas river action plan
Himachal Pradesh government trekking portal: Beas Kund

topics.title: Sindh Sagar Doab aur Thal
topics.summary: Sindh Sagar Doab ka bunyadi river pair Indus aur Jhelum hai. Thal bhi in daryaon ke darmiyan Punjab ka ilaqa hai; maghribi taraf Indus ko yaad rakhein.

references.title: Government of Punjab: Bhakkar and Thal natural resources
Allama Iqbal Open University: Indus Plain and doabs

topics.title: Doab ka matlab aur Bari Doab
topics.summary: Doab do daryaon ke darmiyan zameen ko kehte hain. Bari Doab ke naam ko Ravi aur Beas se jor kar yaad karein; Pakistan ke neeche walay ilaqay ki geography mein Ravi aur Sutlej ki hadbandi bhi milti hai.

references.title: PCRWR: soil properties of the Upper Indus Plain and doabs
Punjab Environmental Protection Department: Bari Doab geography
Primary research: Ravi, Beas and Sutlej floodplain geography

topics.title: Hingol River aur National Park
topics.summary: Hingol Balochistan ke aham daryaon mein shamil hai. Is group mein darya ki pehchan aur isi naam ke National Park ka rishta poocha gaya hai.

references.title: Government of Balochistan: rivers and streams
Department of Archaeology and Museums: Hingol National Park

topics.title: Zhob aur Gomal ka rishta
topics.summary: Zhob River Balochistan se shumal mashriq ki taraf Gomal mein milta hai aur Gomal aage Indus tak jata hai. Yaad rakhne ka silsila: Zhob, phir Gomal, phir Indus.

references.title: Government of Balochistan: drainage systems

topics.title: Balochistan ke darya: Hingol, Dasht aur Porali
topics.summary: Hingol, Dasht aur Porali Balochistan ke aham daryaon ki official list mein hain. In naamon ko Punjab ke Ravi, Jhelum aur Chenab ke sath mix na karein.

references.title: Government of Balochistan: important rivers

topics.title: Indus Basin aur aabpashi
topics.summary: Pakistan ka bara aabpashi nizam Indus Basin se jura hai. Barrages, canals aur zameen ke neeche pani ko alag cheezen samajhne ke bajaye ek doosre se jura hua nizam samjhein.

references.title: World Bank: groundwater resources in Pakistan's Indus Basin

topics.title: Karez: Balochistan ka riwayati pani ka nizam
topics.summary: Karez mein zameen ke neeche dhalwan surangon se pani gravity ki madad se bahar aata hai. Yeh Balochistan ki riwayati aabpashi hai; is ko dam ya pumping system na samjhein.

references.title: UNESCO: Pakistan's Karez System Cultural Landscape

topics.title: Indus Waters Treaty 1960
topics.summary: 19 September 1960 ke muahiday mein maghribi darya Indus, Jhelum aur Chenab Pakistan aur mashriqi darya Ravi, Beas aur Sutlej India ke liye muqarrar hue, kuch muayyan istemal ki ijazaton ke sath. Yeh treaty ke asal tareekhi framework ki revision hai, aaj ki siyasi ya qanooni surat-e-haal ka dawa nahi.

references.title: World Bank: Indus Waters Treaty and the Bank's role
World Bank timeline: treaty signing on 19 September 1960

topics.title: Water Accord 1991 aur IRSA Act 1992
topics.summary: 1991 ka Water Apportionment Accord Pakistan ke subon ke darmiyan Indus system ke pani ki taqseem se mutalliq hai; IRSA ka qanoon 1992 mein aya. Is andaroon-e-Pakistan accord ko India-Pakistan ke 1960 treaty se alag yaad rakhein.

references.title: IRSA: Act No. XXII of 1992 and definition of Water Accord

topics.title: Baglihar: Indian project, Chenab
topics.summary: Baglihar, Chenab par India ka hydropower project hai, Pakistan ka dam nahi. 2005 wale sawal mein Pakistan ke treaty ke tehat uthaye gaye aitraaz murad hain; purane answer option ki wording ko poore project ke khilaf final faisla na samjhein.

questionNotes.ADV2E102-U0011-Q037-SRC: Wazahat: is sawal mein agreement ka naam Indus Waters Treaty hai. Dikhaya gaya purana MCQ answer option Pakistan ke aitraaz ki wording hai, poore project ke khilaf final faisla nahi.

World Bank: treaty mechanisms and the 2007 Baglihar decision

topics.title: Kishanganga: Indian project aur Neelum River
topics.summary: Kishanganga project India ke zair-e-intizam Kashmir mein hai, Pakistan ka dam nahi. Kishanganga ko neeche Pakistan ke zair-e-intizam ilaqay mein Neelum kaha jata hai; isi naam ke farq se related MCQs bante hain.

references.title: NHPC: Kishanganga Hydroelectric Project
AJK Planning and Development: Neelum and Jhelum rivers

topics.title: Tulbul: Indian project, Wular aur Jhelum
topics.summary: Tulbul India ke zair-e-intizam Kashmir ka navigation project hai, Pakistan ka dam nahi. Is ka proposed control structure Wular Lake ke neeche Jhelum par tha; neeche sawalat lake aur river ke isi farq ki practice hain.

references.title: India Ministry of Water Resources: Tulbul project talks, 27 June 2005

topics.title: Dulhasti Stage-II: Indian project, Chenab
topics.summary: Dulhasti Stage-II India ka Chenab par tajweez shuda project hai, Pakistan ka dam nahi. Sawal mein Stage-II ki planned capacity 260 MW hai; is ko pehle se mojood Dulhasti Power Station ki capacity se mix na karein.
